records.japanese:
参ったなぁ
勝手に決めちゃうんだもん
あの人
仲間になるってことなのかな？
records.english: Oh dear. He's decided for himself. Does that mean he's joining us?{PAD}
records.speaker: Rafael Castor (inherited actor zero)
records.context: Alexandria: Cesare reunites with Janus. Rafael wonders whether Cesare is joining; Cesare then offers advice on ship selection. The original Listen/Do not listen branch follows R144.
records.source_meaning: Dismayed that he decided unilaterally; wonders whether that means he is joining the crew.
records.localization_note: Fresh clean-source localization. One logical paragraph with compiler wrapping. 8E51 is the Japanese glyph 参; actor zero is stored before this body, and must remain there.

records.japanese:
あ、そうだ。提督殿
船の選び方について、私の意見を
聞いていただきたいのありますが…
records.english: {SPEAKER:0D}Ah, Admiral. Would you like some advice on choosing a ship?{PAD}
records.speaker: Cesare Tohni (actor 0D)
records.context: Alexandria: Cesare reunites with Janus. Rafael wonders whether Cesare is joining; Cesare then offers advice on ship selection. The original Listen/Do not listen branch follows R144.
records.source_meaning: Ah, Admiral; asks permission to offer his opinion on selecting ships.
records.localization_note: Fresh clean-source localization. One logical paragraph with compiler wrapping. Retain the exact source 0D actor. The offer, not Rafael's rhetorical question, owns the following Yes/No choice.

records.japanese:
とんでもなく大きな槍らしい
邪悪なものを退ける力があるって話だ
records.english: I hear it's an enormous spear capable of driving evil away.{PAD}
records.speaker: Guild informant (user screenshot); original rumor family
records.context: Artifact rumor about an exceptionally large spear and its reputed power to repel evil.
records.source_meaning: It is said to be an enormous spear with the power to ward off evil.
records.localization_note: Wording retained after clean-source review. Replace only obsolete full-width I; keep the actual native expander before wrapping. Native literal-command guard must stay intact.

records.speaker: Faticia nameplate

records.source_meaning: Faticia, the established localized character name.
